name: Dreadful Carnage
prerequisites: Str 15, Power Attack, Furious Focus, base attack bonus +11
benefit:
Whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 or fewer hit points, you can make an Intimidate check to demoralize all enemies within 30 feet as a free action. Enemies that cannot see both you and the enemy you reduced to 0 or fewer hit points are unaffected.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 118
When you reduce an enemy to 0 or fewer hit points, you can spend up to 6 stamina points to increase the radius of this feat’s effect by 5 feet for each stamina point you spent (to a maximum of 60 feet).
flavor: Slaying an enemy demoralizes your other nearby foes.
